dos.text: Just place a plain <hr> inside <panel-list>, panel-list.mjs never creates a separator itself, this is real author-supplied light-DOM content matched by the ::slotted(hr:not([hidden])) rule.

donts.text: Don't look for a dedicated separator class or tagName, there isn't one, styling is entirely via --panel-separator-color/--panel-separator-padding on the plain <hr> itself.
